ruleName: Penalty area – Ball out of bounds or lost
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer stands at the edge of a penalty area looking towards the out of bounds markers beyond a red stake, after her ball has gone out of bounds.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer watches her ball from penalty area go out of bounds

issues: The girl’s left-handedness is not strongly indicated (both hands are visible and it's ambiguous which is dominant), but this does not affect the golf rule or teaching context and is acceptable.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Show the left hand clearly releasing the golf ball to emphasize left-handedness.

questions.title: Ball from the water or sand goes out of bounds
questions.question: You hit your ball from a penalty area, like from a puddle, pond or bunker. The ball flies outside the golf course (out of bounds). What can you do next, following the rules?

choices.text: Drop a new ball near the spot in the penalty area where you last hit, and add one penalty shot.
Add another penalty shot and pick one of the normal penalty area drop choices.
Drop a ball for free where the ball went out of bounds.

questions.explanation: If you play from a penalty area and your ball goes out of bounds, you need to take a penalty. You can either drop a ball near where you last hit in the penalty area for one penalty shot, or take another penalty and use one of the usual ways to drop from a penalty area.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place on the golf course like a pond, puddle, or bunker marked with red or yellow lines where special rules apply.
When your ball goes outside the white lines or fence that shows the edge of the golf course.
An extra shot you have to count in your score because of a rule.
Letting go of your ball from knee height so you can play again.

questions.teachingTip: Show children where a penalty area is and the out of bounds markers. Practise what to do if your ball goes into a penalty area or out of bounds to learn the options.
likelyMisconceptions: Thinking you can drop for free where the ball went out of bounds.
Thinking you get another try without a penalty.

questions.title: Ball from penalty area goes out of bounds
questions.question: You play a shot from a penalty area and your ball ends up out of bounds. Which options do you have for your next shot, following the rules?

choices.text: Drop a ball with one penalty stroke near where you played your last shot in the penalty area
Take another one-stroke penalty and use the penalty area relief options
Take a free drop from where the ball went out of bounds
Replay the shot with no penalty

questions.explanation: If your ball from a penalty area goes out of bounds, you can either drop with a one-stroke penalty near your previous spot in the penalty area, or with another one-stroke penalty, use the normal relief options for a penalty area.
